bug_semantics: A low-privilege customer can set first_name/last_name to a Vue/Blade mustache such as {{7*7}}. The shop profile view prints those fields with Blade {{ $customer->first_name }} / {{ $customer->last_name }} inside the page-wide Vue mount (#app). Blade emits the raw mustache into the DOM; Vue then compiles it, so {{7*7}} renders as 49. The same sink is the profile index page used in GHSA-mqhg-v22x-pqj8 / CVE-2026-21449 (CWE-1336). This is in-DOM Vue template injection (advisory-labeled SSTI); impact is attacker-controlled template evaluation in the shop UI, claimed by the advisory to reach RCE.
flaw_origin: On 2018-07-27, prashant-webkul replaced hardcoded dummy profile table cells ('Prashant'/'Singh') with live Blade interpolations {{ $customer['first_name'] }} and {{ $customer['last_name'] }} in the customer dashboard/profile view, which already extended shop::layouts.master wrapping @yield('content-wrapper') in <div id="app"> and already mounted Vue with new Vue({ el: '#app' }) in shop app.js. That is the first write of user-controlled names into the Vue-compiled profile view. Later path moves (dashboard -> profile/home -> customers/account/profile/index.blade.php) and the 2023 Tailwind/Vue rewrite only restyled or briefly dummy-filled the same sink; da88aab9 restored $customer->first_name after a six-day dummy-data WIP and is not a first write.

reasoning: CVE-2026-21449 / GHSA-mqhg-v22x-pqj8 is a confirmed, non-withdrawn template-injection in Bagisto shop customer profile names. The PoC and the 2.3.10 patch both target packages/Webkul/Shop/src/Resources/views/customers/account/profile/index.blade.php: Blade-printed first_name/last_name sit inside the shop Vue #app, so a customer-supplied {{7*7}} is compiled by Vue after Blade echo. Tracing git log --follow / -S and rename history, the surviving profile index is the same view that began as dashboard/index.blade.php. The smallest first-write is 15043a249ba9d37a9ab4a023ae940ee077c3dd7f, which introduced {{ $customer['first_name'] }} and {{ $customer['last_name'] }} in place of dummy strings while Vue was already mounting #app; the immediate parent 587aaf3961504e85c01ce536355a37692fb092ee still has hardcoded 'Prashant'/'Singh' and no stored-name interpolation. Subsequent path moves, the 2023 dummy-data WIP, and da88aab9's restoration are refactors/reverts, not BICs. The advisory merge 4144931 lands the first security hunk from 2cfca100 (v-text wrap); v2.3.10 also contains b879f893 which replaces v-text with v-pre on the same nodes. AI is judged only from the BIC commit object: 2018 prashant-webkul authorship with no AI/bot trailers, so verdict is NOT_AI.
